originality.rationale: The closest full publicly available spectral-rate result proves only root-rate zero on the two-period centered stratum, which leaves the exact first nonzero Taylor order undetermined. The new result determines that order from the odd harmonic-measure moment and proves that all and only odd orders occur, with explicit positive Kubo–Ando means realizing each. Yamazaki, Osaka–Yamazaki, Zhou–Yang, and Pálfia–Petz give reductions, convergence, and symmetry criteria, not this quantified constructive classification. Searches were actual and their limitations remain stated.

value.rationale: A zero linear spectral factor previously established only supergeometric convergence. The complete classification gives the precise sharp nonlinear order and leading operator-mean invariant, proves all even orders forbidden, and constructs all odd orders with genuine positive harmonic representing measures. The exact order influences double-exponential error complexity. It is a motivated structural classification of an operator-transform regime, not merely a small parameter computation.
